verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LiveKit Agents can make and receive phone calls through LiveKit telephony and outbound SIP trunks. It never mentions sending DTMF keypresses, navigating IVR menus, or detecting or leaving voicemail. General call support is adjacent to this story and does not count as the capability itself, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can send DTMF keypresses, navigate IVR menus, and detect or leave voicemail
